purpose: Add a generated EXTRUDEDSURFACE callback case to the headless DXF 3D consumer probe.
changes: Added a locally authored AC1027 EXTRUDEDSURFACE with distinct sweep vector, extruded/sweep/path transform values, draft/scale parameters, alignment flags, Boolean options, and reference vector.
Asserted selected values delivered by addSurface under ext=false and ext=true.
Exercised both ASCII and Binary DXF via the existing probe runner.
scopeLimit: Generated same-library callback and field-transport evidence only. It does not establish EXTRUDEDSURFACE geometry evaluation, independent interoperability, DWG field semantics, or native consumer support.
fixturePolicy: ASCII and Binary DXF outputs are generated under a temporary directory at runtime and removed; no fixture file was added.
claimEffect: No format support claim changes. S8.3 gains selected EXTRUDEDSURFACE callback-field coverage.
